# BINARY TEST: what every floor VM runs (boot.sh), and the --- PASS line each
# must print (check); a test or subtest that skips, fails or is not there fails
# the floor. The binaries are the ones the root hooks jobs build:
#   hooks       go test -c ./pkg/agent/hooks/linux/ (go-test.yaml)
#   pidmap      the same, -tags 'viper_bind_struct pidmap_integration'
#   proxyconns  the same, -tags 'viper_bind_struct proxyconns_integration'
#               (mock_linux.yml's pid_map_overflow)
# check also requires every test of the two integration tags' files to be
# listed here, so a new one is run at the floors too, not left out unnoticed.
hooks TestTheHooksLoadOnThisKernel
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout/none
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout/canonical
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout/elsewhere
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout/subdir
hooks TestTracefsMountedAgreesWithCiliumInEveryLayout/debugfs
pidmap TestAProcessThePIDMapRefusesIsReported

pidmap TestAReadWaitsForTheUnixReportsTheKernelMadeBeforeIt
pidmap TestAnAbandonedDrainsFlushIsNotTheNextDrainsAnswer
pidmap TestUnderTheSwitchAReplyToTheAppsUDPIsACaptureLoss
pidmap TestAReplyBetweenAReadsEpochMoveAndItsCountTaintsTheNextTest
pidmap TestUnderTheSwitchAnAppsUDPServerIsNotAnsweredLive
pidmap TestUnderTheSwitchABoundClientsAnswerIsCounted
pidmap TestTheHooksObjectLoadsWithTheUDPWatchsMapsAtTheirSmallestWhenOff

pidmap TestUnderTheSwitchTheAgentCountsARestartAndNamesIt
